# Allan & Anne Shirley

- [Allan](../character/allan.md) — Friend of — [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — confidante and minister's wife · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P53](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0053), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P24](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0024)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) prepare to host the new minister, Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and his wife for tea at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) bakes a layer cake for the occasion and decorates the table with ferns and roses. During tea, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) manages his shyness, but when Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) taste Anne's cake, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reacts in horror at its strange taste.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P15](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P29](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P31](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P36](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0036)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decorates the tea table beautifully for the minister and his wife, but her layer cake turns out to be inedible because she accidentally flavored it with Anodyne Liniment instead of vanilla. Devastated by the mistake, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) flees to her room in tears. Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) follows her upstairs to comfort her, kindly forgiving the error and showing her understanding as a kindred spirit.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P29](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P50](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0050)_

> After finishing school, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attends [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations in town, staying with [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). Weeks later, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) brings the official results showing that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tied for first place on the Island. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares the triumphant news with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) before ending her evening with Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md).
>
